mintAuthority.summary: IAUon has issuer-controlled native issuance on Ethereum, BSC, and Solana. Ethereum and BSC native GMTokenManager paths are administered by two-hour beacon-owner timelocks; Solana issuance is controlled by the Ondo GM program PDA whose upgrade authority is a bare system account with unverifiable off-chain custody. Ethereum and BSC OndoOFT overlays, the HyperEVM representation, LayerZero validation, route administration, rate limiting, and representation upgrades are assessed separately in bridgeRouteRisk rather than as native Mint Authority.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (Ethereum) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095805 on 2026-10-01, IAUon getRoleMemberCount(MINTER_ROLE) returned two and getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE,0) returned GMTokenManager 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c. The second member is OndoOFT 0x8ffe0da486a4075e7bbb5763fad4732d41f9667c, which remains in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: IAUon Ethereum/BSC beacon-owner timelocks
controls.evidence: At the current review, Ethereum and BSC IAUon tokens resolve through UpgradeableBeacon contracts 0x985462c9aa4d6c3ad59ae6e1e9c0c11347ed1598 and 0xc046b05a920e4b412815934dd8e58904dda73315. Their owners are distinct TimelockControllers with 7,200-second delays; the BSC timelock proposes through the 4-of-7 Safe 0xa307e57ca7f9712af3557af8c5624bef214aa913, executes/cancels through the 1-of-9 Safe 0x80120c4d44ffd6f86716fd8dacd5e395d8bbbe97 plus EOA 0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b, and is administered by the 5-of-9 Safe 0xa3a3c71380128972f172ff4052af7b6405da6364. HyperEVM representation upgradeability is assessed separately in bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (BSC) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At BSC block 125057090 on 2026-10-01, IAUon MINTER_ROLE count was two: GMTokenManager 0x91f8aff3738825e8eb16fc6f6b1a7a4647bdb299 and bridge OndoOFT 0xeb8ceb319463fdc97f7860211042e2e1abc81f88. Its sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member remained the two-hour timelock 0x8860bbfc7a83e4788a981f4e9f30878331413b26; getMinDelay() returned 7200. The bridge member remains owned by Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Ondo GM Solana program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At finalized slot 453074463, one getMultipleAccounts observation binds the issuer GM program to program-data F4F1ZdqwmT4KfCfCnXrqLp9R6Liq4vEqJcs64xVKTKeU and upgrade authority 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM. Exact Squads v4 PDA derivation binds that off-curve authority to vault index 0 of multisig EfMUASGwCsPBafiPi8rwdZfUJSUt7pxAoxayR39PVpMr (bump 254). Decoded Multisig state has threshold 4, seven permission-mask-7 members, configured time_lock 7200 and zero config_authority. Finalized transaction 5XVxqQtnB44vcJXtMBfobzBzufc6ryVa7YGx4Mf2xNi2GJcMYFpqMq328KMWvxVy8fz8eUCYvNA9XLU2tnVRY8Zp independently executes GM role operations through this Squads vault. Bare system ownership did not prove EOA. Current topology/delay are established; full spending-limit, reconfiguration and Squads upgrade/bypass closure and human independence are not. EVM modules/guards do not apply.

review.evidence: Current review evidence separates native issuance from bridge representations. Ethereum block 25770668 and BSC block 116353763 show GMTokenManager as a native IAUon minter alongside the separate OndoOFT bridge overlay; the native token beacon owners are two-hour timelocks. At finalized Solana slot 439728907, Token-2022 mint M77ZvkZ8zW5udRbuJCbuwSwavRa7bGAZYMTwru8ondo is controlled by the Ondo GM program PDA 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD, and at slot 439729018 its program data reports upgrade authority 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM. At finalized slot 453074463, exact Squads v4 account decoding and vault derivation establish this authority as a 4-of-7 Squads vault with configured 7200-second delay, superseding the earlier bare-system-account EOA inference; full execution/bypass closure and human key independence remain unverified. HyperEVM is a LayerZero bridge representation and its beacon upgrade path is recorded in bridgeRouteRisk. The corrected native control set therefore retains unbounded, periodically reconciled, attestation-only economics and probable confidence.
